It can upscale low-resolution videos, automatically remove unwanted background objects, translate spoken dialogue into multiple languages with matching lip-sync, and perform color grading in seconds. These capabilities save hours of manual labor for professionals and make production accessible to beginners. However, the rapid rise of video AI also brings significant global challenges that society must address. The creation of highly convincing deepfakes poses risks regarding misinformation, identity theft, and political manipulation. Additionally, copyright issues remain highly controversial, as AI models are often trained on intellectual property without explicit consent. As video AI continues to evolve, balancing creative potential with ethical standards will be critical.#AI #ai #morhp #arir #AI
